faqA1: No. Anyone with your room link can join instantly as a guest — no signup, no email, no download required. Only creating a room needs an account.
faqA2: No. For YouTube, Twitch, and Vimeo everyone just needs the link. For local files only the host needs the file — it streams to everyone else. For Netflix, only the host needs a subscription.
faqA3: We automatically detect where the video is currently playing and jump you straight to that exact moment. You're always in sync with the rest of the room instantly.
faqA4: Up to 50 people can watch together in a single room at the same time.
faqA5: Yes, completely free to use. Create rooms, invite friends, and watch together with no cost and no credit card required.
faqA6: SahaPlay works in Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. No plugins or extensions needed. For screenshare with audio we recommend Chrome for best results.
faqA7: Yes — using the Screenshare feature. The host shares their Netflix or Prime tab and everyone in the room sees it in real time. You need a subscription to those services.
faqA8: Yes. Private messages are end-to-end encrypted on your device before they're sent. This means only you and the recipient can read them — not us, not anyone else.

homeFaqA1: SahaPlay currently supports 20 languages: English, Spanish (Español), French (Français), German (Deutsch), Japanese (日本語), Korean (한국어), Chinese (简体中文), Hindi (हिन्दी), Portuguese (Português), Arabic (العربية), Russian (Русский), Italian (Italiano), Telugu (తెలుగు), Tamil (தமிழ்), Bengali (বাংলা), Marathi (मराठी), Gujarati (ગુજરાતી), Malayalam (മലയാളം), Kannada (ಕನ್ನಡ), and Punjabi (ਪੰਜਾਬੀ). You can change your language anytime from the Settings menu.
homeFaqA2: Yes! When you are in a room and another member has their camera turned on, you can hide or unhide their video at any time. Simply click on their video feed and select "Hide Video". You can unhide it the same way whenever you want. This only affects your own view — others in the room are not affected.
homeFaqA3: Yes — using the Screenshare feature. The host shares their Netflix or Prime Video browser tab and everyone in the room sees it in real time. Only the host needs a subscription to those services. Screenshare works best in Chrome browser.
homeFaqA4: SahaPlay automatically tries to reconnect you to the room. Once you are back online, it jumps you to exactly where the video is currently playing — so you never miss anything. Your chat history also reloads automatically.

sfLockModalSubtitle: Keep private conversations protected with a 6-digit PIN.
sfLockSec1Step1: Open the global Conversations window from the chat icon in the top navigation.
sfLockSec1Step2: On the chat you want to lock, click the dropdown arrow or three-dot menu on the far right.
sfLockSec1Step4: If this is your first time, you will be asked to create a 6-digit PIN.
sfLockSec1Step5: After setting the PIN, the app will generate a Master Key.
sfLockSec1Step6: Save the Master Key somewhere safe. It is required if you forget your PIN.
sfLockSec1Step7: Once locked, the chat moves into the Locked Chats folder.
sfLockSec2Step2: Click the three-dot menu at the top-right.
sfLockSec2Step5: After unlocking, you can view all chats inside the Locked Chats folder.
sfLockSec3Desc1: Auto-Lock controls how long a locked chat stays open after you unlock it.
sfLockSec3Desc2: Available options: Immediate · 1 minute · 5 minutes · 15 minutes · Never
sfLockSec3Desc3: After the selected time passes, the chat locks again automatically. To open it again, you must enter the PIN again.
sfLockSec3Path: Settings → Locked Chats → Chat Lock Settings → Auto-Lock Timer
sfLockSec4Desc1: If you lock a private chat from inside a room or from the global Conversations window, it does not disappear completely.
sfLockSec4Desc2: The private chat remains visible in the room or chat list, but shows a lock indicator on the far right.
sfLockSec4Desc3: To open that locked private chat, you must enter the PIN.
sfLockSec4Desc4: Room group chats stay visible to all room members. Chat Lock protects only your personal access to locked conversations.
sfLockSec5Step5: Locked chats become normal chats again.
sfLockSec6Desc1: If you forget your PIN, you can use your Master Key to recover access.
sfLockSec6Desc2: If the Master Key is correct, locked chats open and the user can reset the PIN.
sfLockSec6Desc3: If both PIN and Master Key are forgotten, locked chat data cannot be recovered and must be erased to unlock the vault.
